sources.title: YOLOv8 - Ultralytics Real-Time Computer Vision Model
sources.snippet: YOLOv8 is a computer vision model family developed by Ultralytics and released in January 2023. It builds on earlier YOLO ideas while introducing a redesigned architecture, improved training workflow, and support for multiple computer vision tasks through the Ultralytics framework.
